# Metric as the first statement

Cinetic ecfa6605de1adb9345ce937724810dc32267d068 · MIT · dn-metric-cold-open
Reference data: engine APIs in this source are examples, not Syka instructions.

Category: data_and_numbers; energy: high; role: signature; formats: launch, vertical, feature

## Mechanism
The film opens on its proof number already moving, with no title and no logo, and the brand waits for the end lockup.

## Use when
The product has one strong, true outcome number (users, views, savings) that should earn attention before the name does.

## Avoid when
The number is weak, generic or can't be verified; films where the mark itself must lead.

## Original recipe (adapt to Syka native time and nodes)
Frame 0 is the number mid-count or mid-roll (an ease-out count-up, a digit reel or the macro snap-out) at hero size, cap height about 11% of frame height, centred on the stage colour. The first visible change comes by frame 2, with no fade-up from black. The number settles by frame 40, stays readable for at least 72 f including its unit under a 2% breath push, then hands off on a cut at a motion peak into the problem. Run the story as metric, problem, solution, process, lockup, and keep the logo and product name off screen until the lockup, which stays the only brand moment. Mark the landing with an audio drop: thin or cut the music on the landing frame and allow a designed freeze of at most 15 f there.

## Original timing
First change by frame 2. Settled by frame 40. Readable for 72 f (about frames 41-113). Hand-off cut near frame 113. Optional freeze of at most 15 f on the landing silence.
